messages:
From: Jen Park <jen.park@fintegrate.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintegrate.com
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Forensics onboarding request — scope + preferred transfer method

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intake form earlier. Fintegrate needs to onboard Redwood for a forensics review tied to a late-Aug 19 authentication anomaly. We're preparing a SOC 2 readiness SIG/CAIQ request and need a short-term evidence transfer to our security team. High-level asks: 

- IR plan (current): scope, POC, escalation contact.
- Forensics artifacts for 2026-08-19 21:00 UTC — 2026-08-20 02:00 UTC (auth logs, API gateway traces, token issuance events, S3 access logs, relevant app logs).
- Chain-of-custody form and hash checksums for delivered bundles.
- Preferred transfer: encrypted S3 upload under our bucket, or Redwood-provided encrypted tarball. We require either client-side encryption with our public key or short-lived STS uploads.

Can you confirm what Redwood can provide (raw logs vs. redacted), an estimated delivery ETA, and whether you require an NDA or DocuSign prior to transfer? Procurement will loop in once we understand costs / support hours.

Jen Park
Security Operations
Fintegrate
jen.park@fintegrate.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Forensics onboarding request — scope + preferred transfer method

Hi Jen — thanks for the detail. We can fully support this onboarding and will follow the encrypted transfer + chain-of-custody approach. Summary of what we can deliver and next steps: 

1) What we'll provide 
- App and auth logs (raw, timestamped) for the window you specified.
- API gateway traces and S3 access logs.
- A signed chain_of_custody_form.pdf with SHA256 checksums for each bundle.
- Our IRP excerpt (IRP_Redwood_v3.1.pdf) showing escalation flow and retention policy.

2) Redaction / access model 
- Default: PII redacted by us (names, full email addresses) unless you instruct us to provide raw logs.
- For full forensics we can provide raw logs under a PCN/NDA. If you supply a public key we will produce a client-encrypted tarball.

3) Transfer options (pick one) 
A) You provide S3 bucket + IAM role: we upload with STS and attach chain-of-custody and checksums.
B) You provide a public key: we create a client-encrypted tar.gz and deliver via our secure transfer link.

4) Timeline 
- If you confirm option A or B by EOD today, we can deliver redacted bundles within 6 hours and raw (if requested + NDA) within 24 hours.

5) Proposed short call to align on redaction and timezones — 30 minutes works. I can do 2026-08-20 16:00 UTC. Calendar link on confirmation.

Attachments: IRP_Redwood_v3.1.pdf (IRP excerpt), chain_of_custody_form.pdf (blank template)

CC'd Priyom for logs, Neha for telemetry traces, Karthik for encryption/chain-of-custody handling.

—
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: Internal: Fintegrate evidence pull — owners & ETA

Team — quick coordination thread so Jen sees the public-facing plan but we can move. Jen asked for 2026-08-19 21:00 — 08-20 02:00 UTC window. Actions: 

- Priyom: collect app auth logs (shard clusters: prod-a, prod-b). Include token issuance events and authz failures. ETA 3 hours if you run the query and bundle.
- Neha: extract API gateway traces and S3 access logs (request IDs: start with agw-; we need full body for three calls flagged). ETA 4 hours.
- Karthik: generate a client-side encryption tarball option and prepare chain_of_custody entries. Prepare SHA256 checksums and sign the COC PDF. Also prepare short-lived upload IAM role in case Fintegrate wants STS.

We'll use s3://redwood-secure-transfers/fintegrate-2026-08-20 (bucket restricted to compliance team). Keep raw logs in the encrypted bucket for 7 days, then move to long-term retention per policy. Mark anything flagged by PII scanner and keep an index for Jen.

If anyone anticipates longer than the above ETAs, flag me immediately so I can set expectations with Fintegrate.

—Marissa
